observations.description: 0-2 person(s) detected per sampled frame (median 1); persons present in 92% of 64 samples about 0.57s apart; CV reliability 0.77.
T3 first appears away from the frame edge at 22.8s.
T3: standing posture proxy at 29.4s and low posture posture proxy at 30.0s (transition confidence 0.40; downward change -0.10 body heights, reliability limited).
T3: low/horizontal posture proxy persisted for about 3.9s after the transition.

prediction.temporal_summary: CAM_01: 64 samples over 35.0s; up to 2 person(s). T1 observed 0.0-22.8s (standing -> standing). T3 observed 22.8-33.9s (standing -> low_posture), standing-to-low posture change 29.4-30.0s.
uncertainties: Sparse sampling (about 0.57s between frames); brief actions between samples may be missed.
Boundary semantics (gates, walls, restricted areas) are unavailable; authorization cannot be determined.
Track association reliability is limited (fragmented or ambiguous tracks).
Posture labels are automatic proxies; the cause of a posture change and any medical condition cannot be determined.
prediction.reason: OpenAI Decisions API (gpt-6-luna) typed answers over the compact CV observation state (text only, no images): incident probability 0.30; category 'possible_fall_or_person_down' (confidence 0.71); severity 0.31, imminence 0.36, exposure 0.28, persistence 0.48 (0-1); human-review probability 0.82. Observation texts are generated deterministically from CV features, not by the model.
